title: Pintu Pigeon, CEO
season_arc: Pintu defends Pigeon Express against bigger and stranger delivery machines while building a crew of rooftop misfits.

characters.name: Pintu
characters.personality: Boastful, loyal, quick-thinking, hates being called old-fashioned
characters.voice: Fast, confident Mumbai street voice, slightly nasal
characters.visual_block: Pintu, a plump grey city pigeon with a shiny green-and-purple neck, big expressive brown eyes, wearing a tiny red waistcoat with gold buttons and a miniature black leather satchel across his chest

episodes.title: Pintu Pigeon, CEO. Ep 1: The Drone
episodes.summary: A proud delivery pigeon loses every customer to a 10-minute delivery drone, until one lunch box needs to go where no drone can fly.
episodes.cliffhanger: A hundred drones rise over the skyline behind Pintu.
